name: Simple Water Bodies' Mapping (SWBM)
description: Detects surface water in Sentinel-2 L2A scenes using an OR-ensemble of three normalized-difference indices (MNDWI, NDWI, SWI). Water pixels render blue; non-water pixels render as 2x true colour. Thresholds default to the Sentinel Hub evalscript values (MNDWI_thr=0.1, NDWI_thr=0.2, SWI_thr=0.03) and may be calibrated per scene using the histogram inspection procedure described in the original script. Adapted from a SentinelHub Custom Script by Mohor Gartner.
